title: Even-r Multi-User Security Bound for SXoP
summary: For even r at least four, the multi-user SXoP bound combines two different bounds and is conjectured not to be tight; improve it or find a matching attack.

formal_statement.body: Improve the multi-user security bound for $\mathrm{SXoP}[r,n]$ when $r$ is even and $r\ge 4$, or devise a matching attack.

scope.domain: Multi-user symmetric-cryptographic security analysis of SXoP.
assumptions: r is even and at least 4.
parameters: r: SXoP parameter restricted here to even values at least 4
scope.unresolved_remainder: Improve the current multi-user security bound for SXoP[r,n] in this regime, or devise a matching attack.

citations.label: Combining Outputs of a Random Permutation: New Constructions and Tight Security Bounds by Fourier Analysis

progress.summary: The source says the even-r multi-user bound is obtained by combining two different bounds and conjectures that it is not tight in all settings. It leaves improving the bound or devising a matching attack to future work.
citation_labels: Itai Dinur et al., Combining Outputs of a Random Permutation: New Constructions and Tight Security Bounds by Fourier Analysis
